# articulated girdle

[Project home](../../../../README.md) · [Folder guide](../../../../Documentation/project_structure.md)

Source or model data. Refer to the main data guide for units and provenance.

- [ASSUMPTIONS.json](ASSUMPTIONS.json) — Documented geometric and model-assembly assumptions.
- [cat.xml](cat.xml) — MuJoCo model topology: connected bodies, joints, geometric objects and muscle paths.
- [mechanics_exact.npz](mechanics_exact.npz) — Numerical body and joint properties used when assembling the skeletal dynamics.
- [muscle_parameters.npz](muscle_parameters.npz) — Numerical muscle architecture and strength arrays associated with the mechanical model.
- [reference.npz](reference.npz) — reference — named numerical arrays.
